claims.review: project self-review; not independent or completely formal
claims.hypotheses: At most q=3/4 reactive branches and at most one L or one C; finite positive ordinary values, arbitrary R and placements; same seven samples.
passed_obligations: Exact prefix/suffix minima are evaluated on every fiber vertex; nonnegative actual coefficients turn sums into lower P(sigma), Q(sigma), P(T) bounds even at tiny sigma.
Cross-polynomial interpolation degree <=q+2 is exact; scalar weights and all monomial identities are checked with rational arithmetic.
Rounding induction is acyclic: q3 uses q2; q4 uses its same-kind q3 margin. Removing sole L/C uses pure RC/RL. All delta+4eta inequalities are strict.
One-L finite Y0 DC trial bounds Ys by Y0+nC sigma/eta; DC-open included, DC-short separately excluded. Whole q4 imaginary guard is automatic, not assumed.
One-C DC-open is an actual series-C/RL port bridge; infinity-short is direct C shunt. Remaining endpoint trials include Z0=0 and Yinf=0 before exact lower bounds prove positive endpoints.
Endpoint unit-current limits bound L currents by one; infinity unit-voltage limits bound L drops by one. Thus trial errors are nL sigma/eta and nL/(T eta).
All one-C bracket factors are positive, so replacing r0,rinf,e,|Zi|^2 by exact outward bounds is valid. Strict interval contradictions and population union are separate checks.
